question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
    SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
review_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
packing_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(
      date_diff('hour', CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP))
    ) as avg_packing_hours
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
    AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    pct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) as category_sales
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pct.product_category_name_english
),
top_category AS (
  SELECT 
    seller_id,
    product_category_name_english as top_category
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      seller_id,
      product_category_name_english,
      category_sales,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM category_sales
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  sm.seller_id,
  sm.total_quantity,
  ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
  ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
  ROUND(COALESCE(rm.avg_review_score, 0), 2) as avg_review_score,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pm.avg_packing_hours, 0), 2) as avg_packing_hours,
  tc.top_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN review_metrics rm ON sm.seller_id = rm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN packing_metrics pm ON sm.seller_id = pm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN top_category tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
